name: Raleigh and the Undercity
summary: In Brill and the Undercity, a ring draws Raleigh into an old tragedy. Magistrate Sevren sends you to return Deliah's ring to her widowed husband, found after her stolen corpse was bound for Fenris Isle.

sections.title: A Tragic Heirloom
sections.body: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren has pieced together clues about a stolen corpse and an engraved ring. The ring belonged to Deliah, and Sevren hopes to learn where it came from and return it to her family. He sends you into the Undercity to find Raleigh, Deliah's surviving husband.

sections.title: Cold Hearts, Bitter Vengeance
sections.body: In the Trade Quarter of the Undercity, Raleigh Andrean recognizes his former wife's ring at once. Like many of the Forsaken, undeath has left him unable to grieve Deliah's death or the desecration of her remains. Yet a thirst for retribution still burns in him. Raleigh plots revenge against those who violated her final rest.

aliases: where do i get raleigh and the undercity
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren sends you from Brill in Tirisfal Glades after you return Deliah's Ring to him.
Raleigh Andrean is in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, among its merchants and craftsmen.
The ring belonged to Deliah, a woman from Brill who was Raleigh Andrean's wife before Lordaeron fell.

faq.q: Why doesn't Raleigh mourn his dead wife?
faq.answer: As one of the Forsaken, Raleigh says that grief and love have grown cold within his undead heart. Vengeance is what remains.
When you hand over the ring, Raleigh sends you to avenge his wife's desecration.

faq.q: How was Deliah's ring found initially?
aliases: where did the ring come from
faq.answer: Deliah's ring was taken from her hand among the wrapped corpses on a boat at the Decrepit Ferry in Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As an Undead, Raleigh's cold response reflects the Forsaken's shared anguish. Their mortal attachments have faded into bitter wrath.
As a member of the Horde, you carry tokens of old Lordaeron through the gates of the Undercity. They show the somber shape of life among your Forsaken allies.
